major.summary: The provider-gated PostgreSQL repository test did not enter the request-scoped client context.
major.evidence: PostgreSQL repository reads use the db proxy, which requires withPgClient; the first test called the repository directly.
major.impact: The live test would fail before exercising project, relationship and release filtering.
major.recommendation: Import withPgClient and wrap the repository read, following the established sibling provider-test pattern.

verification_gaps.summary: The run had no final verification record yet.
verification_gaps.evidence: Repository-wide checks and live PostgreSQL were intentionally pending review.
verification_gaps.impact: Acceptance must wait for the planned commands and durable evidence.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Run and record focused, live-provider and repository-wide verification after repair.

verification_gaps.summary: Error and refresh interactions lacked direct component coverage.
verification_gaps.evidence: The initial test covered the pure list while the page render covered only pending copy.
verification_gaps.impact: The new retry and manual-refresh controls could regress without dispatch evidence.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Add a query-state harness covering labelled loading/fetching, error retry and manual refresh.

do_not_change.evidence: The strict wrapper exposes only the safe Recommendation and nullable Signal ID.
do_not_change.impact: Prevents Run IDs, graph relationships and raw evidence from crossing the client or MCP boundary.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep the DTO and existing signal-qualified review path unchanged.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve active-controller qualification and accepted-card read-only behavior.
do_not_change.evidence: The read is project/request/controller/unreleased-qualified, and accepted cards never render investigation controls.
do_not_change.impact: Protects tenant isolation and legacy lifecycle safety.
do_not_change.recommendation: Do not add read-time source inference or accepted review controls.
